action_summary: macro_v1 stored plan, successes and failures with no record of the STATE either outcome happened in. A count can only argue against a plan everywhere, so two failures in one context erased a plan that worked in every other context -- the error its own docstring records four sightings of. Adds applicability_v1, a conjunction version-space learner over observed facts reusing settlement_v1.VersionSpace and the same grammar as what_a_success_teaches_20261112.py, and a bounded per-outcome-class evidence log in macro_v1. Executed both arms on identical experience: the counter-only path loses the plan; the context-aware path keeps it, offers it where it works and withholds it where it fails, counting 0 global failures and 2 scoped ones. Withholding uses the least demanding survivor, so it is sound while the exact requirement is still AMBIGUOUS and never manufactures a ban. One success plus one failure leaves 2 survivors; a contrasting success identifies the requirement exactly. Callers passing no context are byte-behaviour identical. Rebased onto the environment-address repair that landed in parallel: macro_v1 now carries BOTH `where` (which environment, isolating ledgers) and `context` (what was true, learning the requirement). They are independent and both test suites pass together; two added tests pin that an address alone still offers the plan in a failing environment and can say nothing about an unseen one, which a requirement over facts can refuse.
explicit_user_authorization: Owner directive 2026-11-12: instant learning in arbitrary new environments is already solved, so giving the model the smartest actions once yields permanent mastery and total computer use -- what is true, what is wrong, what are the real limiting factors, and the fastest optimal path. Standing directives honored: first principles, kill bad ideas before implementing, assume a million mistakes and prevent them, reuse what already exists under non-obvious names, maximize web use, $0 spend, zero model dependency, push and merge.

recursive_obs.real_outcome: A remembered plan survives failures that belong to a context it does not cover, and is withheld in that context, instead of being erased for every context.
recursive_obs.required_capability: Retained (state, outcome) pairs and a learner that reports what they do and do not determine, because necessity is only refuted by failure and a success is a point rather than a quantifier.

obs_goal.real_outcome: Owner asks whether one exposure to the best actions yields permanent mastery. Permanence requires knowing where the retained plan applies, and the store previously could not represent that.

routes_ranked: 1. ADAPT macro_v1 to retain (state, outcome) and scope failures with a version-space learner -- smallest change that alters what the system can conclude
2. Wire live callers to pass the facts world_probe_v1 already decides -- follows once the store is trustworthy
3. Close the 11 BLIND premises so more applicability conditions are decidable at all
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: A new store or a new learner duplicates machinery that already exists and is already measured. Tuning the drop threshold cannot distinguish two contexts that produce the same scalar. Harvesting an external library would put a donor in the producer path.

obs_verification.synthetic_verification_necessity: The subject is this tree's own store, so it is executed rather than modelled: both arms run the real record/note_failure/lookup path against a redirected state file. Four controls make it falsifiable, and a mutation to the strictest-survivor rule is caught by a named test. The production learner is cross-checked against the survivors of the probe that motivated it, so the earlier 0/200 measurement still describes the code that runs.
